newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: BALTICS-LITHUANIA SEES Q4 SHARE LINK WITH ESTONIA,LATVIA.
newsitem.headline: BALTICS-LITHUANIA SEES Q4 SHARE LINK WITH ESTONIA,LATVIA.

text.p: Lithuania's central depository said on Thursday that it was interested in signing an agreement to link with he Latvian and Estonian depositories but did not think it was possible until the fourth quarter of this year.
Latvia and Estonia have already signed an agreement that will come into operation this summer which allows the settlement of each others securities in their own countries.
Lithuania has so far held back amid worries from brokers over competition from more aggressive Estonian players.

"We are getting ready to open the settlement bridges between the Lithuanian, Latvian and Estonian central depositories but it is unlikely that they will be open earlier than the fourth quarter of 1997," Lithuania central depository head Arturas Keleras told Reuters.
He noted that Lithuanian brokers wanted a delay to the signing of such an agreement.
"Some of the dealers are reluctant to do that because they wish to keep a monopoly on the settlement services, that the capital of the Baltic countries goes via them," he added.
But he said that any future linking between the bourses would be a good rehearsal for entering into contact with the settlement systems of the European Union.
